heading: Online Reviews for Multi-Location Brands: FAQ

questions.q: Do online reviews still matter for restaurants?
questions.a: Yes, reviews are still one of the first places customers find and judge your business. Guests trust real experiences from other people, so recent, relevant reviews make them more likely to visit. Higher ratings are linked to more revenue and more repeat customers.

questions.q: How do reviews affect restaurant revenue?
questions.a: Better ratings bring in more customers and higher spending. Harvard Business School research found that one extra star on Yelp can lead to a revenue increase of 5-9%. Responding to reviews and improving your rating can also win back revenue lost to negative feedback.

questions.q: Why are reviews especially important for multi-location brands?
questions.a: Customers see one bad experience at a single store as a reflection of the whole brand. A run of negative reviews at one location can drive away potential customers everywhere. That makes consistent review monitoring and responses across every location essential.

questions.q: Should I respond to every online review?
questions.a: Responding to every review shows guests that no one is ignored, and it encourages repeat business. Replies to negative reviews give you a chance to fix the problem and win the guest back, and replies to positive ones reinforce loyalty. For multi-location brands, Momos AI Review Manager replies to reviews 24/7 from a Unified Inbox so every location keeps up.

questions.q: How can I get more customer reviews?
questions.a: Ask at the right moment and give guests a reason to share. Post-visit surveys paired with vouchers or coupons, and loyalty programs that reward feedback, raise review volume and bring guests back. They also give you feedback you can use to improve operations at each location.
